seo.intro: London operates the world's busiest metropolitan airport system. Intercontinental services primarily depart from London Heathrow (LHR) and London Gatwick (LGW), offering direct routes across Europe, North America, Asia, and Africa.
seo.title: Direct Flights from London: Nonstop Routes & Airports | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Explore nonstop global connections across six continents from London's airport network
seo.meta_description: Discover nonstop flights departing London. Compare Heathrow (LHR), Gatwick (LGW), flight times, and operating airlines.

faqs.answer: London Heathrow (LHR) serves the majority of global flag carriers and long-haul connections. London Gatwick (LGW) combines major European routes with transatlantic and leisure long-haul services.
faqs.question: Which airport should I use when departing London?

faqs.answer: The Heathrow Express connects Heathrow Terminals 2/3 directly to London Paddington in 15 minutes. The Elizabeth Line provides direct cross-London rail transit without transfers in 30 to 40 minutes.
faqs.question: What is the fastest way to travel between Heathrow and central London?

faqs.answer: Direct National Express coach services run between Heathrow and Gatwick in roughly 65 to 80 minutes. Travelers should budget at least 3.5 to 4 hours between connecting flights.
